accepted.s: Which institution projected India's growth at 6.6 per cent for 2026-27 in June 2026?
accepted.x: The Reserve Bank of India projected India's growth at 6.6 per cent for 2026-27 in June 2026.
accepted.tq: Match the agency directly with its forecast.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the growth projections for India:
1. The World Bank projected 6.6 per cent growth for FY27 in its June 2026 Global Economic Prospects.
2. The World Bank reduced its FY27 projection from 7.2 per cent made in April.
3. The World Bank projected 7.2 per cent growth for FY28.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The World Bank projected 6.6 per cent for FY27 after cutting its earlier 7.2 per cent projection and projected 7.2 per cent for FY28.
accepted.tq: Use the coded combination to verify all three figures and years.

accepted.s: With reference to the IMF's projections for India, which one of the following is correct?
o: 2025-26 was raised to 7.3 per cent and FY27 was projected at about 6.2 per cent.
2025-26 was raised to 6.2 per cent and FY27 was projected at 7.3 per cent.
2025-26 was projected at 6.6 per cent and FY27 at 7.2 per cent.
Both 2025-26 and FY27 were projected at 7.3 per cent.
accepted.x: The IMF raised its 2025-26 projection to 7.3 per cent in January 2026 and projected about 6.2 per cent for FY27 in April 2026.
accepted.tq: Separate the agency, year and direction of revision before choosing.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes S&P's assessment of India?
o: India was upgraded from BBB- to BBB in 2025, the first such upgrade in nearly two decades, and BBB was affirmed in September 2026.
India was upgraded from BBB to BBB- in 2025.
India received an AAA rating for the first time in 2025.
India was downgraded from BBB to BBB- in September 2026.
accepted.x: S&P upgraded India from BBB- to BBB in 2025, its first upgrade in nearly two decades, and affirmed the BBB rating in September 2026.
accepted.tq: Watch for reversed rating movements and swapped rating grades.

accepted.s: India's growth during the period under consideration was driven mainly by which combination?
o: Foreign aid and reduction in public investment
Strong private consumption and public investment
accepted.x: The principal growth drivers identified were strong private consumption and public investment.
accepted.tq: Identify the precise cause-effect combination rather than a broad growth claim.

accepted.s: The interest rate on EPF deposits for 2025-26 was fixed at:
accepted.x: The EPF interest rate for 2025-26 was 8.25 per cent and remained unchanged.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the EPF rate from the nearby small-savings rates.
accepted.sec: Savings and insurance - EPF, small savings, insurance products

accepted.s: The EPF interest for 2025-26 was credited to approximately how many accounts on 15 July 2026?
accepted.x: EPF interest was credited to 34 crore accounts on 15 July 2026.
accepted.tq: Check the unit and magnitude carefully in a large-number question.
accepted.sec: Savings and insurance - EPF, small savings, insurance products

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly represents the EPF contribution structure?
o: 10 per cent by the employee and 12 per cent by the employer
12 per cent by the employee and 12 per cent by the employer
8.25 per cent by the employee and 8.25 per cent by the employer
12 per cent by the employee and 8.25 per cent by the employer
accepted.x: The EPF contribution remains 12 per cent from the employee and 12 per cent from the employer.
accepted.tq: Separate the contribution percentages from the interest rate.
accepted.sec: Savings and insurance - EPF, small savings, insurance products

accepted.s: The EPF interest rate of 8.25 per cent for 2025-26 was recommended by the EPFO Central Board of Trustees on:
accepted.x: The EPFO Central Board of Trustees recommended the rate on 2 March 2026; it was subsequently approved by the Finance Ministry.
accepted.tq: Use the institutional sequence and distinguish recommendation from approval and crediting.
accepted.sec: Savings and insurance - EPF, small savings, insurance products

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched with the small-savings rate for Q1 of FY27?
o: Post Office savings account — 7.1 per cent
accepted.x: The NSC rate was 7.7 per cent. SSY was 8.2 per cent, PPF and the three-year term deposit were 7.1 per cent, and the post-office savings rate was 4 per cent.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure rate-product pair and eliminate swapped rates.
accepted.sec: Savings and insurance - EPF, small savings, insurance products

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about small-savings schemes:
1. Their rates remained unchanged for the eighth consecutive quarter from 1 April 2026.
2. The rates are set quarterly by the Finance Ministry.
3. The rates are linked to Government securities yields.
4. The funds are credited to the National Small Savings Fund in the Public Account.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. Small-savings rates were unchanged for the eighth straight quarter, are set quarterly by the Finance Ministry, linked to G-Sec yields and credited to the National Small Savings Fund in the Public Account.
accepted.tq: Test the full institutional chain rather than only the interest figures.
accepted.sec: Savings and insurance - EPF, small savings, insurance products

accepted.s: The 'Micro Bachat' micro-insurance plan was launched by:
accepted.x: LIC launched the 'Micro Bachat' micro-insurance plan.
accepted.tq: Use the organisation-product association directly.
accepted.sec: Savings and insurance - EPF, small savings, insurance products

accepted.s: The Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha Act, 2025 provided for what limit of FDI in insurance?
accepted.x: The Act allowed 100 per cent foreign direct investment in insurance.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the new limit from commonly used intermediate percentages.
accepted.sec: Savings and insurance - EPF, small savings, insurance products

accepted.s: India's insurance penetration was reported to be approximately:
accepted.x: Insurance penetration remained stuck at 3.7 per cent according to the Economic Survey 2025-26.
accepted.tq: Read the decimal figure precisely; nearby digits are the trap.
accepted.sec: Savings and insurance - EPF, small savings, insurance products

accepted.s: Which of the following statements is correct regarding the issue of currency in India?
o: The Government of India issues banknotes and the RBI issues coins.
The RBI issues banknotes under Section 22 of the RBI Act, while coins are issued by the Government of India under the Coinage Act, 2011.
Both banknotes and coins are issued exclusively by the RBI.
Both banknotes and coins are issued exclusively by the Ministry of Finance under the RBI Act.
accepted.x: Banknotes are issued by the RBI under Section 22 of the RBI Act, whereas coins are issued by the Government of India under the Coinage Act, 2011.
accepted.tq: Apply the 'who would do this job?' method to distinguish note and coin authorities.
accepted.sec: Currency events - demonetisation, new notes → authority

accepted.s: Demonetisation of the ₹500 and ₹1,000 notes was announced by the Government of India on:
accepted.x: The Government announced demonetisation of the ₹500 and ₹1,000 notes on 8 November 2016.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the exact announcement date from nearby November dates.
accepted.sec: Currency events - demonetisation, new notes → authority

accepted.s: As of September 2026, India's foreign exchange reserves of $785.71 billion made it the world's:
o: Fifth-largest holder, after China, Japan, Switzerland and Russia
Fourth-largest holder, after China, Japan and Switzerland
Third-largest holder, after China and Japan
accepted.x: With reserves of $785.71 billion, India became the fourth-largest holder after China, Japan and Switzerland, overtaking Russia.
accepted.tq: Use the stated ranking and identify the country displaced from the list.
accepted.sec: Currency events - demonetisation, new notes → authority

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding new banknote issues in 2025-26 is correct?
o: A new ₹2,000 banknote series was issued in 2025-26.
A new banknote series was issued in 2025-26 by the RBI.
No new banknote series was reported for 2025-26.
A new banknote series was issued jointly by the RBI and the Government of India.
accepted.x: No new banknote series was reported for 2025-26.
accepted.tq: Look for the explicit exception instead of assuming a currency redesign.
accepted.sec: Currency events - demonetisation, new notes → authority

accepted.s: Which country overtook the United States of America as India's largest trading partner in 2025-26?
accepted.x: China overtook the United States as India's biggest trading partner in 2025-26.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the trading partner from the major crude supplier and FDI source.
accepted.sec: External sector - trade partners, crude suppliers, FDI sources

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding India's external sector:
1. The merchandise trade deficit was $333.2 billion.
2. The current account deficit was 1.1 per cent of GDP.
3. Services exports increased by 15.3 per cent.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The merchandise trade deficit was $333.2 billion, the current account deficit was 1.1 per cent of GDP, and services exports rose by 15.3 per cent.
accepted.tq: Verify each numerical statement independently before selecting the coded option.
accepted.sec: External sector - trade partners, crude suppliers, FDI sources

accepted.s: In June 2026, Russia accounted for approximately what share of India's crude oil imports?
accepted.x: Russia supplied approximately 48 per cent of India's crude imports in June 2026, with its share rising since the West Asia war.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the exact percentage from nearby rounded alternatives.
accepted.sec: External sector - trade partners, crude suppliers, FDI sources

accepted.s: The US Senate was advancing a proposal for a tariff of what rate on buyers of Russian oil?
accepted.x: The US Senate was advancing a proposal for a 100 per cent tariff on buyers of Russian oil.
accepted.tq: Watch for the extreme numerical value when the source gives a precise rate.
accepted.sec: External sector - trade partners, crude suppliers, FDI sources

accepted.s: More than 75 per cent of India's FDI inflows in April 2026 came from which group of countries?
o: China, Russia and the United States
Japan, China and the United Kingdom
accepted.x: Japan, Singapore and Mauritius together accounted for over 75 per cent of India's FDI inflows in April 2026.
accepted.tq: Group the countries by their stated FDI relationship rather than by trade status.
accepted.sec: External sector - trade partners, crude suppliers, FDI sources

accepted.s: The March 2026 relaxation of Press Note 3 allowed firms with Chinese ownership of up to what level to use the automatic route?
accepted.x: Press Note 3 was eased to permit firms with up to 10 per cent Chinese stake to use the automatic route.
accepted.tq: Separate the precise threshold from higher FDI-limit figures.
accepted.sec: External sector - trade partners, crude suppliers, FDI sources

accepted.s: Who presented the Union Budget 2026-27 on 1 February 2026?
accepted.x: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman presented the Union Budget 2026-27 on 1 February 2026.
accepted.tq: Match the document with the responsible constitutional-political office-holder.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding Budget 2026-27:
1. The fiscal deficit was budgeted at 4.3 per cent of GDP.
2. The revised estimate of fiscal deficit for 2025-26 was 4.4 per cent of GDP.
3. The debt-GDP ratio was 55.6 per cent.
4. The Government aimed to reduce the debt-GDP ratio to 50 ± 1 per cent by 2030-31.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. Budget 2026-27 set the fiscal deficit at 4.3 per cent, recorded the 2025-26 revised estimate at 4.4 per cent, reported debt-GDP at 55.6 per cent and targeted 50 ± 1 per cent by 2030-31.
accepted.tq: Keep the budget estimate, revised estimate and medium-term target separate.

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs correctly represents the capital expenditure figures in Union Budget 2026-27?
o: Capex ₹12.22 lakh crore and effective capex ₹17.15 lakh crore
Capex ₹17.15 lakh crore and effective capex ₹53.47 lakh crore
Capex ₹17.15 lakh crore and effective capex ₹12.22 lakh crore
Capex ₹12.22 lakh crore and effective capex ₹53.47 lakh crore
accepted.x: Budget 2026-27 provided ₹12.22 lakh crore as capex and ₹17.15 lakh crore as effective capex.
accepted.tq: Compare the two similarly named expenditure figures instead of the total spending figure.

accepted.s: The total expenditure proposed in Union Budget 2026-27 was:
accepted.x: The total spending proposed in Budget 2026-27 was ₹53.47 lakh crore.
accepted.tq: Separate total expenditure from capex and effective capex.

accepted.s: Which of the following statements about the tax measures in Budget 2026-27 is correct?
o: The Income Tax Act, 2025 came into force on 1 April 2025, and TCS was abolished for all LRS transactions.
The Income Tax Act, 2025 came into force on 1 January 2026, and TCS was raised from 2 per cent to 5 per cent.
The Income Tax Act, 2025 came into force on 1 April 2026, and TCS on LRS for education and medical purposes was reduced from 5 per cent to 2 per cent.
The Income Tax Act, 2025 came into force on 1 April 2026, and TCS on education and medical LRS was raised to 10 per cent.
accepted.x: The Income Tax Act, 2025 took effect from 1 April 2026, while TCS on LRS remittances for education and medical purposes was cut from 5 per cent to 2 per cent.
accepted.tq: Check both the commencement date and the direction of the tax-rate change.

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT correctly matched with the Budget 2026-27 tax or policy measure?
o: Foreign cloud firms using Indian data centres — tax holiday up to 2047
States' share of divisible pool — retained at 41 per cent
Monazite — basic customs duty reduced to nil
Foreign cloud firms using Indian data centres — tax holiday up to 2030
accepted.x: The tax holiday for eligible foreign cloud firms using Indian data centres was provided up to 2047, not 2030. The other three pairs are correctly matched.
accepted.tq: Find the single changed end-year in an otherwise familiar policy statement.

accepted.s: Which set of projects was announced as new industrial or freight initiatives in Budget 2026-27?
o: BHAVYA industrial parks, East Coast Industrial Corridor with Durgapur node, and Surat-Dankuni freight corridor
BHAVYA industrial parks, Delhi-Mumbai Industrial Corridor, and Chennai-Kolkata freight corridor
National Industrial Corridor, Durgapur port and Surat-Mumbai freight corridor
East Coast Industrial Corridor with Mumbai node, BHAVYA ports and Dankuni-Surat highway
accepted.x: The new initiatives included BHAVYA industrial parks, the East Coast Industrial Corridor with a Durgapur node and the Surat-Dankuni freight corridor.
accepted.tq: Match each named project with its exact node or corridor description.

accepted.s: Who was the Chief Economic Adviser associated with the Economic Survey 2025-26?
accepted.x: V. Anantha Nageswaran was the Chief Economic Adviser associated with the Economic Survey 2025-26.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the Survey's authoring official from the Finance Minister who tables it.

accepted.s: The core theme of the Economic Survey 2025-26 was:
o: Strategic Indispensability and Entrepreneurial Policy Making
accepted.x: The core theme was 'Strategic Indispensability', accompanied by the idea of entrepreneurial policy making.
accepted.tq: Recall the exact official phrase rather than a broad economic slogan.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the Economic Survey 2025-26:
1. It contained 17 chapters.
2. It reported FY25 fiscal deficit at 4.8 per cent.
3. It recorded three rating upgrades.
4. It was prepared by NITI Aayog.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1, 2 and 3 are correct. The Survey is prepared by the Economic Division of the Department of Economic Affairs in the Ministry of Finance, under the Chief Economic Adviser, not by NITI Aayog.
accepted.tq: Use the wrong-authority trap to reject the statement assigning preparation to NITI Aayog.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the preparation and presentation of the Economic Survey?
o: It is prepared by the Economic Division of DEA under the Chief Economic Adviser and is conventionally tabled a day before the Union Budget.
It is prepared by the Finance Commission and tabled by the Prime Minister a week before the Budget.
It is prepared by NITI Aayog and tabled by the RBI Governor after the Budget.
It is prepared by the RBI and tabled by the Finance Secretary after the Budget.
accepted.x: The Survey is prepared by the Economic Division of the Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance, under the Chief Economic Adviser, and is tabled a day before the Budget.
accepted.tq: Ask which institution would perform the preparation and tabling functions.

accepted.s: The Economic Survey of India was first presented in:
accepted.x: The first Economic Survey was presented in 1950-51.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the first year of the Survey from the year it was delinked from the Budget.

accepted.s: The Economic Survey was delinked from the Union Budget in:
accepted.x: The Economic Survey was delinked from the Budget in 1964.
accepted.tq: Use the institutional-history date rather than the first-Survey date.

accepted.s:
Which of the following correctly represents the Economic Survey 2025-26 projections and risk assessment?
1. FY27 real GDP growth was projected at 6.8–7.2 per cent.
2. Medium-term potential growth was raised from 6.5 per cent to 7 per cent.
3. The Survey assessed a 10–20 per cent chance of a crisis worse than 2008.
4. FY25 fiscal deficit was 4.9 per cent against a target of 4.8 per cent.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1, 2 and 3 are correct. The FY25 fiscal deficit achieved was 4.8 per cent against a target of 4.9 per cent, so statement 4 reverses the figures.
accepted.tq: Check the direction of the target-versus-achievement comparison.

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the code given below:
List-I (Concept or index)
A. Chakravyuha challenge
B. Universal Basic Income
C. Thalinomics
D. Bare Necessities Index

List-II (Economic Survey)

accepted.s: From 2026, Lok Sabha members received which additional form of the Economic Survey?
o: A classified copy through email only
An audio copy through All India Radio
accepted.x: From 2026, Lok Sabha members also received a soft copy of the Economic Survey on WhatsApp.
accepted.tq: Identify the distinctive delivery medium in a current-affairs detail.

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Bare Necessities Index — first introduced in Economic Survey 2019-20
Chakravyuha challenge — exit problem of firms
Thalinomics — first introduced in Economic Survey 2016-17
Universal Basic Income — first introduced in Economic Survey 2020-21
accepted.x: The Chakravyuha challenge referred to the exit problem of firms. Thalinomics was introduced in 2019-20, the Bare Necessities Index in 2020-21 and UBI in 2016-17.
accepted.tq: Use the concept-definition pair first, then reject the swapped Survey years.
